hints.title: Greedy Reduction of Largest Piles
hints.text: Removing floor(pile / 2) stones yields the largest reduction when applied to the pile currently containing the most stones.

hints.title: Priority Selection of Maximums
hints.text: Store pile sizes in a prioritized container supporting rapid maximum retrieval and re-insertion.

hints.title: Repeating for K Operations
hints.text: Repeat k times: extract the largest pile, subtract floor(pile / 2), and re-insert the remainder.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-sorting the array on each of K operations takes O(K * N log N), causing timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Priority heap maintains maximum order in O(log N) time per operation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize max-heap for iterative greedy extraction.
